title: Ketorolac Pricing by Payer Class and Account Class — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Pricing methodology bulletin.** Ketorolac (code J1885 under revenue code 0636), on an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), is priced reading its billed units from the account's charge postings:

- **Commercial HMO Claim for an Observation Stay Account:** the lesser of its charges and its billed units times 3.40 USD.
- **Commercial PPO Claim for an Emergency Department Visit Account:** its billed units times 3.40 USD.
- **Otherwise:** the payer class's expected allowed percentage of its charges.

Ketorolac's value is never above its billed charges.

| Hypothetical case (3 units, charges 12.00) | Value |
|---|---|
| Commercial HMO Claim, Observation Stay Account | 10.20 |
| Commercial PPO Claim, Emergency Department Visit Account | 10.20 |
| Commercial PPO Claim, Observation Stay Account | expected allowed percentage of 12.00 |
| Commercial HMO Claim, Emergency Department Visit Account | expected allowed percentage of 12.00 |
